scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; ua="$npm_config_user_agent"; ep="$npm_execpath"; case "$ua" in *pnpm*) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$ep" in *pnpm*) exit 0 ;; esac; echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
